protocol.subset: 120 curated public images; 60 proxy-positive and 60 proxy-negative
protocol.method: leave-one-out 7-nearest-neighbour vote in each persisted image-embedding space
protocol.operatingPoint: queue when at least 5 of 7 neighbours are proxy-positive
protocol.thresholdRationale: The same fixed supermajority rule is applied to both models; no threshold was fit to maximize a metric.
protocol.claimBoundary: Object-label proxy only; not a production content-policy classifier or prevalence estimate.
